title: RNA extraction from hairy roots of common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) and cDNA synthesis
author: Ronal Pacheco
materials: Macerate root tissue using liquid nitrogen.
Preparation of RNA samples for cDNA synthesis

steps.title: Initial Tissue Lysis
steps.instruction: Load 100 mg of macerated tissue into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and add 1 mL of TRIzol Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15596026). If tissue is less than 100 mg, add the equivalent amount of TRIzol.

steps.title: First RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA through initial lysis and phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Mix by vortexing for 15 seconds and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 11,800 rpm, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.
Add 200 µL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), mix by vortexing for 15 seconds, and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 500 µL of isopropanol, mix by immersion, and incubate overnight at -20 °C (minimum 6 h recommended for higher concentration).
Centrifuge at 11,800 rpm, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: RNA Purification with LiCl
steps.instruction: Use Lithium Chloride to increase RNA concentration and purity.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 4 M LiCl, rinse the pellet (do not resuspend), and vortex slowly.
Centrifuge at 5,900 rpm, 4 °C, for 20 minutes.
Discard the LiCl phase, removing all remnants using a micropipette or syringe.

steps.title: Second RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Further purify the RNA using tris-EDTA and chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of tris-EDTA buffer (pH 8) and resuspend RNA by vortexing.
Add 500 µL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1 v/v) and mix by vortexing.
Centrifuge at 5,900 rpm, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Final RNA Precipitation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final precipitation and resuspension of the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of isopropanol and 66 µL of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Mix by immersion and incubate overnight at -20 °C (minimum 6 h recommended).
Centrifuge at 11,800 rpm, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Discard the aqueous phase and vacuum or air dry the RNA pellet.
Resuspend RNA pellets using nuclease-free water (preferably DEPC-treated water).

steps.title: RNA Quality Control and Quantification
steps.instruction: Verify RNA integrity and determine concentration.

substeps.instruction: Check RNA integrity in a 1% agarose gel treated with bleach.
Prepare a 1/10 dilution of each RNA sample and quantify concentration using a NanoDrop™ 2000c Spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #ND-2000C) or equivalent.
Prepare one aliquot of 10 µL of each RNA sample at 10 ng/μl.

steps.title: Genomic DNA Removal
steps.instruction: Treat RNA samples with DNase I to remove genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of DNase I recombinant RNase-free (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #04716728001) and 1 µL of the corresponding 10X buffer to each sample (or add 2 µL of a 1:1 v/v mix of DNase and buffer).
Incubate samples for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Perform a qPCR assay to verify the removal of genomic DNA.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the purified RNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 10 mM oligo (dT) to each sample, incubate for 5 minutes at 70 °C, then immediately incubate on ice for 3 minutes.
Prepare a RT mix containing 1 µL of RevertAid Reverse Transcriptase (200 U/µL, Thermo Fisher Catalog #EP0442), 4 µL of 5X buffer, and 2 µL dNTP mix.
Add 7 µL of the RT mix to each RNA sample.
Incubate for 1 hour 30 minutes at 42 °C, followed by 10 minutes at 70 °C.
Store cDNA samples at -20 °C.
